methodology.percentiles: Nearest rank: sorted values[ceil(p*n)-1]. All completed native attempts count, including calls whose downstream processor rejected their proposal. This is not a measure of idle no-call processing latency.
methodology.wall_ms: Capture elapsed wall time for each native call.
methodology.classification: superseded: explicit runtime superseded_call_ids or superseded reader/judge prompt version; repeats: remaining nonprimary run_id or repeat>0; primary: remaining calls. Groups are disjoint. Primary includes development and holdout unless scoped.
methodology.retrieval_latency: unknown: contexts.json did not record retrieval timings; not inferred from native-call timing.
